summary: E2E testing of /taxatie public landing + /admin/taxatie-aanvragen admin dashboard. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend submission flow (form fill + 9 photo uploads + submit) succeeds with success state. Admin dashboard loads, filter tabs show counts, row click opens detail modal with bedrijfsgegevens grid + 9 photos + status select + Start BPM Taxatie button + Verwijderen button. Sidebar shows new 'Taxatie-aanvragen' link. Static file serving (/api/uploads/taxatie_aanvragen/*) returns 200 image/png. Customer auto-create + upsert (no duplicate) verified. Taxateur role can also access the admin endpoint.

issues: Photo labels derived via prefix.split('_', maxsplit=5)[-1] in _save_file, so 'km_stand' becomes 'stand', 'motorfiets_links' becomes 'links', 'inkoop_verklaring' becomes 'verklaring', etc. Labels are terse but functional. Consider storing the explicit field key in saved_files[].field for prettier modal labels.

action_items: (Optional polish) In routers/taxatie_aanvraag.py _save_file: set 'field' to the explicit field key (e.g., 'km_stand', 'inkoop_verklaring') rather than splitting prefix, so admin modal labels are descriptive instead of 'stand', 'verklaring', 'links', 'voor', 'achter'.
critical_code_review_comments: _save_file reads upload.file synchronously (upload.file.read()) - acceptable for small photos but would block event loop for large files.
Notification email is best-effort (try/except) - won't fail submission if SMTP is down.
Customer upsert key is (created_by, name_slug) - case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed.
Status update uses hard-coded whitelist {nieuw,in_behandeling,afgerond,afgewezen} - safe.
DELETE endpoint removes files from disk best-effort then deletes DB record - safe order.
